messages.text: The result justifies our cooperation: stores survived, Spear fought and the Guild earned its contract, but the reserve is spent and the beacon needs repair. I support T1's Navigation article independently, provided both Guild owners seal its Lantern commitment. I also support its Military article independently, provided both army owners seal Spear. Guard requires Vigil offered as well; that remains a political promise, not a second commitment. I ask the army to state that intention plainly. Readiness three after a repair-and-protection month is acceptable to me. Joint delegates have already agreed a difficult operation; this is a credible opportunity to exercise their authority.

reason: No amendment requested. These are negotiating positions, not formal signatures; confidence depends on actual owner approvals and a funded Guard plan.
